name: realtor-ai-admin
description: The Agent Leverage OS — a real estate agent's AI executive assistant, 11 skills deep. The front door understands any admin ask in plain English, then the specialists take it: Scheduling (conflict-checked booking, guests invited, video link attached, reschedules and route planning), Inbox (drafts and replies in the agent's voice), the weekday Inbox Sweep, the 7am Briefing, Client Memory (total recall of every client, note, and promise), Meeting Prep (a 5-line brief before any appointment), End-of-Day Wrap (close today, load tomorrow, from the car), on-the-go Dispatch (just talk while mobile — it captures, acts, and reports back), and Match-Back (name a property and it finds the buyers already in their notes, with a personal draft to each). REQUIRES the Realtor AI Brain plugin (same marketplace): install it and run 'Set up my Brain' first — the AI Admin reads everything from the Brain and never re-interviews the agent.
